title: v2.1.321
excerpt: What's changed Added Claude Fable 5.2 ( claude-fable-5-2 ), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads Added --settings <file> to claude remote-control , which applies a settings file to every session it starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart claude remote-control Fixed MCP OAuth requests sending secrets such as refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected them Fixed a case where a read-only Bash command ran outside the sandbox without a permission prompt Fixed a case where Bash permission checks judged a file write from the wrong folder and didn't prompt Fixed deny rules and protected-file prompts not applying to the file that a cp or mv into a directory writes Fixed the "Draws from usage credits" note showing after a switch to Fable on Enterprise seats whose plan includes Fable Fixed the fallback model sometimes declining a request or mentioning a stopped response when the first model was blocked before replying Fixed claude mcp login printing a SEP-2352 issuer warning each time you sign in again to a server that Claude Code registered with Fixed NotebookEdit deleting or overwriting a notebook's first cell when the call named no cell, on network paths (UNC shares, WSL folders, /net mounts) Fixed Edit changing the first of several matches, replacing a whole file on an empty old_string , or editing a notebook as text, on network paths (UNC shares, WSL folders, /net mounts) Fixed /config showin
